pressQ1.zh: 惊喜之夜把剧场拆成一条可走的路径，而你是路径本身。
pressQ1.en: Surprise Night turns the theatre into a path you walk — and you are the path.

pressQ2.zh: 在惊喜之夜，故事不是被观看的，而是被进入的。
pressQ2.en: At Surprise Night, stories aren't watched — they're entered.

pressQ3.zh: 它不急着解释一切，而是先让你相信这个世界真的存在。
pressQ3.en: It doesn't rush to explain everything — first it lets you believe this world truly exists.

pressQ4.zh: 这不是一次演出安排，而是一种被精心建造的在场经验。
pressQ4.en: This isn't a show on a schedule — it's a carefully built experience of presence.

press1Src.zh: 合作方与观众反馈（摘录）

press2.zh: 在东方留白里做沉浸，需要勇气；他们有这样的勇气。
press2.en: Immersive work with Eastern restraint takes nerve - they have it.

press3.zh: 不是「看戏」，是被放进故事里--这一点，他们说得诚实。
press3.en: Not watching a show - being placed inside the story. They mean it.

servicesH.en: What we can do for you

svc1d.zh: 将成熟项目带入剧院、商业体与城市更新空间，完整制作与巡演执行。
svc1d.en: Bring proven shows to theatres, retail spaces and urban projects - full production and touring.

svc2d.zh: 为文旅、酒店与综合体打造专属驻演，内容与运营一体生长。
svc2d.en: Long-run shows for culture, hospitality and mixed-use - content and operations together.

svc3d.zh: 从 0 到 1 的沉浸式叙事与空间体验，为目的地建立差异化内容资产。
svc3d.en: From scratch: narrative and spatial experience that differentiates a destination.

svc4d.zh: 与院团共创：用当代沉浸语言重塑传统戏曲，触达年轻观众。
svc4d.en: With companies: reframe traditional opera for younger audiences through immersion.

svc5d.zh: 项目出海与引进双向通道，国际制作协作与文化交流报批支持。
svc5d.en: Export and import tours - production partnerships and cultural exchange support.

svc6d.zh: 沉浸式品牌体验与事件传播，兼顾质感与 UGC 友好设计。
svc6d.en: Immersive brand worlds and events - crafted for shareability.

svc7d.zh: 文学、影视、游戏与世界观 IP 的线下沉浸转译与长期运营。
svc7d.en: Turn literature, film, games and lore into walkable experiences - built to last.

serve1d.zh: 市场部与品牌总监关注传播势能与调性匹配。我们提供可量化社交扩散的沉浸事件与共创叙事。
serve1d.en: Marketing and brand leads care about reach and fit - we deliver immersive events built to travel.

serve2d.zh: 项目总与运营团队关注客流、复购与内容差异化。我们用空间叙事拉长停留与回访理由。
serve2d.en: Developers and operators need dwell time and return visits - spatial narrative is our lever.

serve3d.zh: 策划与项目经理关注执行效率与创意唯一性。我们交付从概念到现场的全链路制作统筹。
serve3d.en: Producers need execution and singularity - concept to show floor, one team.

news1.zh: 官网策划 V2 上线：合作产品矩阵与逐屏线框同步至开发实现。
news1.en: Site V2 live: collaboration matrix and screen blueprints shipped to build.

news2.zh: 旗舰项目持续巡演筹备中，欢迎通过合作中心获取引进资料包。
news2.en: Flagship tours in prep - request touring packs via Collaborate.

news3.zh: 沉浸式互动剧目《生存游戏》于重演浸空间（金源店）完成首轮驻演。
news3.en: THE SURVIVOR completed its first run at Chongyan Immersive Space (Jinyuan).
